title: Boy in 1930s Suit, 1936 Los Angeles Vintage Snapshot Photo
back_text_transcription: BALDWIN-GRUBER, L. A. APR 27 1936 VELOX PRINT A 65
description: A sharp 1936 vintage snapshot photograph featuring a young boy smartly dressed in a 1930s light-colored suit, sweater, and white dress shoes, standing outdoors on a sidewalk beside a tall hedge. The back of the photo features a round photofinishing stamp from Baldwin-Gruber in Los Angeles dated April 27, 1936, printed on Velox paper.
